question: Does explicit independently supplied fixture feedback change inductively learned native two-hop relation templates and improve unfamiliar-subject predictions, rather than just copying directly observed Q/P/Q facts?
hypothesis: For synthetic shifted relation p15, 8 disclosed feedback examples will switch a deterministic integer rule preference; on 12 thereafter unseen subjects transfer top1 from 3/12 static to 9/12 feedback. Strong exact-symbolic equal-evidence control must tie both and scientific_pass remains false.

sources.visible: source-free, developer-generated synthetic Q/P/Q fixture staged through NKR08 synthetic-only intake
sources.real_source: Original full historical TRAIN source is already consumed and not downloaded/scanned in this experiment; actual base integration was qualified by NKR08
sources.protected: No Wikidata valid/test, independent evaluation source, external first-use, or live action consequence outcomes
sources.authenticity: engineered fixture only; source SHA is byte identity, not proof of a real-world event

representation.discover: Enumerate (p1,p2)->p3 candidates only when training source has both connected path observations and explicit target edge. Learn p3 and composition pair identifiers from evidence; do not seed p3 mapping. No absent-edge negative inference.
representation.feedback: positive observed target object with synthetic fixture-only source_ref; immutable SHA-pinned receipt and checkpoint; one update per heldout subject and target relation; weight=4 frozen; never admit inferred candidate to factual memory or causal observed-action bank
representation.readout: bounded path hypotheses ranked by integer support+4*(public feedback hits) with deterministic tie; abstain if no supported relation rule

fixture.generator: deterministic fixed-identity numeric Q/P/Q facts, no RNG, subjects 1..64, intermediates=10000+s,30000+s, endpoints=20000+s,40000+s
fixture.train_subjects: 1..32; both paths visible, direct p15 target A for 24 subjects and target B for 8; p16 reverse, all fixture labels disclosed to learning
fixture.feedback_subjects: 33..40, direct target p15 all B; target labels withheld until after initial predictions, then 8 source-authentication-unverified fixture feedback points disclosed
fixture.cold_subjects: 41..52, target p15 B for 9 subjects and A for 3; target labels never admitted to knowledge/feedback during evaluation
fixture.retention_subjects: 53..64, target p16 B for 9 and A for 3; no p16 feedback, no target edges ingested
fixture.target_mining: must produce two p15 and two p16 candidate rules with counts exactly 24 and 8 in training; not a preseeded relation map
fixture.negative_control: query nonexistent target p29 must abstain; wrong/ambiguous feedback and unsupported source kind denied

evaluation.primary: Cold p15 Hits@1 on 12 withheld subjects after feedback vs static frozen learner at identical source, target labels withheld until predictions are sealed
evaluation.preset_success: after feedback at least 9/12 correct, static no feedback 3/12, delta>=4; p16 retained top1 >=9/12, unknown relation abstain
evaluation.fully_fitted_symbolic: Separate independent exact count-based symbolic learner given identical training edges and eight disclosed feedback labels; expected equal 9/12 (no architectural superiority)
evaluation.costs: log source fact rows, feedback count, rule count, candidate count, cold checkpoint bytes, prediction wall time; do not claim controlled speedup

gates.engineering: Ubuntu+Windows source-free focused, negative and full original regression at exact candidate SHA/tree; G29 generated-only and independent qualification
gates.science: Development simulation only; cannot establish real new knowledge, outside-family learning, causal mechanism, or dominance over fully trained conventional controls
gates.admission: draft isolated research only; no merge/main/accepted-native/owner-runner promotion
